watches.name: Celebi V 245/264 Fusion Strike Alt Art
watches._note: Pokemon (first non-One-Piece watch). Fusion Strike has NO regular Celebi V — 245/264 is the sole Celebi V in the set, so name+number uniquely identifies the alt art. Sig 1 = celebi v + full number (245264, incl. the common 245/265 typo). Sig 2 = celebi v + set + bare 245 + alt-art descriptor, guarding the collision-prone bare '245' (which substring-hits '245 cards' counts/certs). Excludes anchored ('cards lot' not bare 'lot', which would hit 'Holo Trading'->'holotrading'). Verified offline: 12/12 real titles matched, 12/12 confusables (Gengar VMAX 270/264, Genesect/Boltund 24x, bulk lots, sealed, jumbo, Japanese) rejected.
queries: celebi v 245/264 fusion strike alt art

watches.name: Giratina V Alt Art 186/196 (Lost Origin)
watches._note: Pokemon. Identify by number 186/196 (normalizes to '186196'): a contiguous substring unique to this card — the regular V is 130/196, and every Giratina VSTAR is 131/201/212. Require the bare name 'giratina' (NOT 'giratina v', whose norm 'giratinav' is a prefix of 'giratinavstar') + '186/196'; also exclude 'vstar' belt-and-suspenders. Excludes anchored ('cards lot' not bare 'lot', which would drop 'Holo TCG'->'holotcg'). Verified offline: 12/12 real titles matched, 14/14 confusables (regular V 130, VSTAR 131/201/212, Full Art 185/196, jumbo, master set/ETB/booster box, Japanese) rejected.
